part.text:
Implemented `Handler` for `MethodRouter` so state-dependent method routers can be passed directly to `Router::fallback`, enabling:

```rust
router
    .fallback(get(fallback).fallback(not_found))
    .with_state(state);
```

Validated with `cargo test -p axum --lib --all-features`: 271 passed.
